### Ashes to Ashes
Author: Sarah Jennings
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/crosswalk-the-devotional-feb-23-2009-11599907.html
Passage: Genesis 3:19
Points:
- Returning to dust reflects the entrance of physical death into the world after the fall.
- Scriptural practices use dust and ashes to signify deep grief over sin and heartfelt repentance.
- Acknowledging human sinfulness directs believers to depend on God's mercy rather than self-righteousness.
- Contemplating mortality should ultimately foster gratitude for Christ's redemption and resurrection victory.

### Dust and Grace
Author: Sophia Bricker
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-nightly-prayer/dust-and-grace.html
Passage: Genesis 3:19
Points:
- Humanity was uniquely crafted by God from the ground, yet sin brought mortality and return to dust.
- Remembering that our days are short humbles human pride and encourages wise living.
- Jesus entered human weakness and bore the cross to redeem humanity from the curse of sin.
- Through Christ's resurrection, believers receive the promise of eternal life instead of permanent death.
